dialogues.speaker: Czcibor
dialogues.text: You seem to have great adaptability for it. I envy that — my friends say I used to be hypersensitive to kuuvahki. Nosebleeds for days, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Czcibor
dialogues.text: But now, I don't get 'em as much. I'm not really sure how the accident was related to this, but that's all there is to it.
